summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a Share Purchase Agreement on August 17, 2026, to acquire Alesta Therapeutics B.V., a Dutch rare-disease biotech, via a cash-free, debt-free share purchase. Terms include $275 million upfront cash (subject to post-closing adjustment) plus up to $215 million in development milestone payments. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to customary conditions including a pre-closing transfer of certain Alesta assets to SpinCo and absence of injunctive relief. The Purchase Agreement is filed as Exhibit 2.1. Watch for regulatory approvals and milestone-triggered payouts.
